about_the_game:
₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ Cozy Collectors Unite ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊

With over 100 Nimikin designs each with additional color variations you will have plenty of precious companions to collect and love. 

₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ Your Game, Your Choice ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊

Nimikins is designed with the idea that everyone likes something different. Every Nimikin starts out with the same stats. Level up your favorites to unlock islands, complete expeditions, accomplish quests, and more.

₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ Gacha Gains, Wallet Wins ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊

We love playing gacha games, but we don’t love what it does to our wallets. We want our game to give you the joy of gacha with no microtransactions. That’s why each life preserving capsule (egg in Earth speak) contains a chance for an adorable Nimikin or one of its extra special versions!

₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ Craft, Accessorize, and Vibe ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊

Craft dozens of glamourous accessories. Our goal is to take you away with immersive music and fun accessory decorating. Take your favorite Nimikin and dress them up to multiply the cuteness ~!

₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ Explore a Brand-New World ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊

Each Nimikin you find comes with a bit of information about their lore or a hint at the world around them. Learn more about the Goddess Aerie, Luminara, Umbra and the Sky Isles where our story takes place!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 250 MB available space

short_description: Nimikins is a cozy idle game. Collect over 100 adorable Nimikins and discover rare, shimmering color variations as you reunite them with their goddess, Aerie. Craft accessories to grow their strength and express your unique personality.
